goal: Build POC-1 book ingestion: extract clean Arabic text from PDF/TXT/EPUB, normalize encoding, detect paragraphs, produce CSV review output

subgoals.title: Implement Arabic text normalizer
subgoals.description: NFKC normalization to convert Presentation Forms to standard Arabic, strip tatweel, normalize whitespace. Returns stats for encoding report.

subgoals.title: Implement TXT extractor and ingest orchestrator
subgoals.description: Read TXT files with encoding detection, split paragraphs by blank lines, wire up the ingest() entry point that produces clean_text.txt and paragraphs.csv.

subgoals.title: Implement PDF extractor with noise stripping
subgoals.description: Extract Arabic text from Hindawi PDFs via PyMuPDF, strip page headers and publisher pages, detect paragraph boundaries from text block structure.

subgoals.title: Find EPUB test book and implement EPUB extractor
subgoals.description: Download 1 legally free Arabic fiction EPUB (Hindawi or archive.org). Implement extraction via ebooklib + BeautifulSoup HTML parsing.

subgoals.title: Integration testing on all book formats
subgoals.description: Run ingest pipeline on all test books (2 TXT, 3 PDF, 1 EPUB), validate CSV output, fix edge cases found during real-book testing.
